Answer: F
Reason: The chest radiograph demonstrates dextrocardia (heart on the right) and a gastric bubble on the right, confirming situs inversus totalis. In Kartagener's syndrome with situs inversus, the anatomical left lung is located on the patient's right side; the image shows more pronounced bronchiectatic changes (coarse reticular markings and tram-tracking) in this morphological left lung, consistent with the expected pattern.
